subject: gk
question: The organisers of Wimbledon Open did NOT allow players of two countries to compete in the Wimbledon 2022. One of them was Russia, which was the other country?
solution: The correct answer is __**Belarus**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The organizers of the Wimbledon Open did not allow players of two countries to compete in Wimbledon 2022. • One of them was **Russia, and the other country is Belarus.** • The ITF has however banned Russia and Belarus from the **Davis Cup and the Billie Jean King Cup.**
